skill.name: hubspot-automation
skill.description: Automate HubSpot CRM workflows through Rube MCP, including contacts, companies, deals, tickets, and custom properties.
skill.summary: Guides agents through HubSpot CRM searches, batch operations, pipeline lookups, ticket searches, and custom property setup through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most command-execution findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around HubSpot and Rube MCP tool names. The real risks are third-party MCP network access and OAuth-backed HubSpot read and write operations. No prompt injection language was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Third-party MCP endpoint handles HubSpot workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Document Rube MCP trust assumptions, OAuth scopes, tenant verification, and data retention expectations before installation.

remediation.issue: CRM write operations can alter records and properties.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation for create, update, and batch operations, and recommend testing in a sandbox first.

remediation.issue: Tool schemas and CRM property metadata can change.
remediation.suggestion: Refresh Rube tool schemas and HubSpot property metadata before running write workflows.

content.value_statement: HubSpot teams often repeat CRM searches, imports, and property setup by hand. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows for core CRM tasks.
actual_capabilities: Checks Rube MCP availability and HubSpot connection status before workflows run.
Searches and creates HubSpot contacts while checking for duplicates.
Searches, creates, and updates HubSpot companies in batches up to 100.
Searches deals and maps pipeline, stage, and owner identifiers.
Searches support tickets with filters and cursor pagination.
Creates and updates custom CRM properties after reading metadata.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active HubSpot OAuth connection.
Does not provide HubSpot credentials or choose permission scopes.
Cannot bypass HubSpot batch limits or schema validation rules.
Write actions need careful review because they change CRM records.

use_cases.title: Prepare CRM Imports
use_cases.description: Search for existing contacts and companies, then create missing records in safe batch sizes.

use_cases.title: Review Pipeline Activity
use_cases.description: Find deals by pipeline, stage, owner, or date range and resolve internal HubSpot identifiers.

use_cases.title: Manage Support Data
use_cases.description: Search tickets by status or date and discover exact property names for reporting workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Check HubSpot Access
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the HubSpot automation skill to verify that Rube MCP is available and my HubSpot connection is active. Report account status and missing setup steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create Missing Contacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Search HubSpot for these contacts first. Create only contacts that do not already exist, then summarize created records, skipped duplicates, and any validation errors.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Deal Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Find deals in the requested pipeline and stage. Resolve pipeline and owner names, paginate as needed, and summarize deal count, value, and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Design Property Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Review existing company properties and property groups. Propose a new enumeration property, confirm values with me, then create it only after approval.

output_examples.input: Search for Acme contacts and create any missing people from my list.
output: Found three existing Acme contacts and flagged one duplicate email.
Prepared one new contact for creation after validating required fields.
Returned created record details and recommended a follow-up owner review.

output_examples.input: Find open Enterprise deals created this quarter and group them by owner.
output: Resolved the Enterprise pipeline and active stages before searching deals.
Grouped matching deals by owner and highlighted records without an assigned owner.
Included pagination status and fields that were unavailable in the response.

output_examples.input: Create a renewal status property for companies after checking existing fields.
output: Reviewed current company properties and confirmed no matching internal name exists.
Proposed labels, values, and property group placement for approval.
Created the property only after confirmation and summarized the final configuration.

best_practices: Confirm the HubSpot account, OAuth connection, and permissions before any workflow.
Search existing records before creating or updating contacts and companies.
Review batch sizes, internal property names, and enumeration values before writes.
anti_patterns: Creating contacts or companies without a duplicate search first.
Using display labels when HubSpot requires internal property names.
Running broad write operations without explicit approval and rollback planning.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It guides HubSpot CRM tasks for contacts, companies, deals, tickets, pipelines, owners, and custom properties through Rube MCP.

faq.question: Does it require a HubSpot connection?
faq.answer: Yes. Rube MCP must be available, and HubSpot OAuth must show an active connection before workflows run.

faq.question: Can it create or update CRM data?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create and update records and properties, so review every write action before execution.

faq.question: How does it avoid duplicate records?
faq.answer: The workflow searches existing HubSpot records before create actions and recommends using returned IDs for later steps.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when Rube MCP tools are configured.

faq.question: What should I verify before batch imports?
faq.answer: Verify required fields, internal property names, enum values, batch size limits, and approval for production changes.
